meta.title: DMR-Graph
meta.subtitle: Knowledge graph of the Mailroom constellation
meta.note: Hub v0.8.0 is the pre-prune rollback point (all ten packages present); DMR-079 then pruned llm-entity-extraction, llm-mailroom-graph and agent-mailroom, leaving the seven core packages mapped here.

relations.feeds: data or control flows into the target (stage → stage, dataset → consumer)
relations.produces: the source creates a derived artifact
relations.depends: code or config dependency (version pin, vendored snapshot, import)
relations.traces: runtime telemetry is emitted to an observability sink
relations.renders: the surface displays data coming from the target
relations.serves: the component owns or exposes the target surface / entrypoint
relations.governs: policy, gate or board authority over the target
relations.syncs: mirror, subtree, fork or upload reconciliation
relations.prunes: removed from the monorepo by DMR-079

zones.label: Data & corpora
zones.blurb: Raw corpora, corpus-feed packages and the pinned Hugging Face datasets.

zones.label: Evaluation & prompts
zones.blurb: The one definition of "correct", per-node evals and calibration, the classifier, and the prompt loop.

zones.label: Pipeline & runtime
zones.blurb: llm-mailroom's 13-node graph, its auxiliary lanes, persistence, the reloaded pipeline and the sandbox.

zones.label: Surfaces
zones.blurb: What humans look at — console, Observatory, TUI, terminals, boards, graph sites.

zones.label: Hub, governance & release
zones.blurb: The monorepo, its board, its scripts and gates, the issue hub and the release milestones.

zones.label: External platforms
zones.blurb: Providers, tracing sinks, GPU hosts and storage outside the repos.

data.label: CMU Enron corpus
data.desc: Maildir 20150507 tarball — 517,390 parseable emails across ~150 custodians.

data.label: CMS DE-SynPUF (Sample 1)
data.desc: 2008–2010 Medicare claims — 11.15M claim events, 116,352 beneficiaries, ~$1.62B paid.

data.label: Enron-Evaluation-Environment
data.desc: Enron corpus EDA → pipeline-ready correspondence corpus (10 subclass keys; deduplicated by construction).

data.label: claims-data-eda
data.desc: CMS DE-SynPUF EDA → plain-text EOB documents with ground truth aligned to InsuranceClaimExtraction.

data.label: mailroom-corpus-eda
data.desc: Canonical-dataset EDA (P0–P6) + the central Hugging Face upload helpers (hf_interface, dataset_export, docclass_uploader, intent_backfill).

data.label: mailroom-corpus
data.desc: Frozen v8 baseline (2,000 rows) and parent of the canonical corpus; the archived v7/v8 publisher's source.

data.label: mailroom-dataset
data.desc: Core corpus: 3,302 documents, 5 classes, 55 class×subclass strata (2,979 train / 323 test). Consumers pin a revision, never a live tip.
data.version: schema v9 · consumers pin v9.1 (ed7576b6) · Hub tip v9.2

data.label: enron-correspondence-dedup
data.desc: Deduplicated, subclass-labelled correspondence rows contributed to the canonical corpus.

data.label: cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims
data.desc: EOB-rendered insurance_claim documents contributed to the canonical corpus.

data.label: mailroom-cuad-contracts
data.desc: CUAD page-image vision surface (50 rows + 546 PNGs); the text+clause mirror beside it is the corpus feeder.

data.label: mailroom-cuad-contracts-full
data.desc: Byte-verified CUAD text+clause mirror (510 rows) — the real contract feeder (509 rows) and a registry ingest of llm-mailroom.

data.label: legalbench-full
data.desc: LegalBench mirror used by the extraction prompt experiments.

data.label: docclass-pilot
data.desc: 48-stratum pilot slice of docclass-merged v5 (138 rows): pipeline pilot examples and the visualizer's pilot dataset.

data.label: mailroom-modernbert-training
data.desc: Leak-free, clerk-normalized training set for the ModernBERT ingest classifier.

data.label: mailroom-sorter-handoff
data.desc: sorter_handoff gold labels — the staging payload for the intended sorter_handoff config (publishes no data files yet).

data.label: mailroom-reloaded-fixtures
data.desc: Fixture adaptation (v9.2 mirror, 3,302 rows) for the mailroom-reloaded pipeline.

data.label: GNOTHEIA synthetic claims
data.desc: 200 synthetic property-claim documents contributing to the insurance_claim class.

data.label: BDR motor claims
data.desc: BDR auto-insurance claim corpus — 150 rows in v8, 300 auto rows in v9.

data.label: INSURBIAS
data.desc: 150 narrative auto-claim rows added to the corpus in v9.

data.label: MAUD v1
data.desc: 152 merger_agreement rows (Zenodo 7500064) — the merger specialist's checklist source corpus.

data.label: llm-dojo-scoring
data.desc: The only place a metric is defined — field-type-aware scoring, error analysis, interpretation. llm-mailroom pins v0.22.0; reloaded v0.21.0 parity.

data.label: eval-environment
data.desc: Per-node evals (31-task registry), pilot scenarios and calibration suites over the canonical dataset; holds the frozen v1 prompt lineage and the GEPA loop.

data.label: mailroom-ml
data.desc: ModernBERT ingest fast-path classifier: training, per-head calibration, ONNX-on-CPU serving. A standalone contractor repo, not a governed member.

data.label: mailroom-modernbert-classifier
data.desc: The published ModernBERT bundle mailroom-ml serves: five document classes plus per-class subclass heads, calibrated, exported to ONNX.

data.label: atticus-investigation
data.desc: Adjacent eval sibling: LegalBench classification prompt-engineering pipeline — same methodology, separate focus.

data.label: llm-entity-extraction
data.desc: Prompt-experiment loop and source of the vendored sorter/contracts prompts. Pruned in DMR-079 — standalone only, no longer synced.

data.label: Entity-Extraction-Experiments
data.desc: Organization copy of the prompt loop (v0.20.0 lineage). Pruned/standalone — kept only as history.

data.label: eval-environment viewer
data.desc: Run viewer and environment dashboard — static, zero-dependency, live on Vercel.

data.label: calibration harness
data.desc: Per-node reliability/ECE sweeps and threshold recommendations: intake, classify, judge, arbiter, retry, boss, archivist.

data.label: frozen v1 prompt lineage
data.desc: sha256-locked baseline (sorter_v1 + five specialist stems + rubrics) that every mutation is A/B'd against; reference copies live in mailroom-issues.

data.label: GEPA mutation loop
data.desc: Reflective prompt evolution run from eval-environment: select parent → reflect on traces (ASI) → propose mutation → strict-improvement gates.

data.label: prompt lineage
data.desc: Winners are vendored into llm-mailroom's langchain_agents/; production prompts are managed in Langfuse as mailroom-<agent> with the production label.

data.label: experiment log
data.desc: Append-only run index (reports/experiment_log.jsonl + data/experiments/<run_id>/); the entity-extraction log is the archived lineage.

data.label: llm-mailroom (package “mailroom”)
data.desc: The 13-node LangGraph pipeline and FastAPI producer — the centre of the constellation.

data.label: intake
data.desc: Ingest specialist — one fused TRIAGE + CLEAN + PREPARE pass over sliding windows.

data.label: classify
data.desc: Sorter agent: one of five document classes plus subclass.

data.label: retry_classify
data.desc: Classification retry arm after a gate miss.

data.label: review_classify
data.desc: Lane A second opinion (sorter reviewer) — stays live in production.

data.label: extract
data.desc: Class specialist pulls the class checklist fields.

data.label: retry_extract
data.desc: Extraction retry arm after a gate miss.

data.label: judge_verify
data.desc: Judge-verify: an independent verdict on the extraction.

data.label: arbiter
data.desc: Arbitrates conflicts between extraction verdicts.

data.label: human_review
data.desc: Review queue for low-confidence or disputed documents.

data.label: boss_escalation
data.desc: Boss escalation — adjudicates the hard conflicts.

data.label: compile_report
data.desc: Computational procedural reporter: deterministic matter record, no LLM call.

data.label: catalog_write
data.desc: Writes the matter catalog entry and window stats.

data.label: archive
data.desc: Archives the document with a hash-chained audit entry.

data.label: START entry route
data.desc: START router: an approved review-resume re-invocation (resume_extraction + review_decision=approved + doc_type) skips straight to extract; everything else runs intake → classify.

data.label: ModernBERT fast path
data.desc: Advisory ingest prior: the ModernBERT classifier composes onto the sorter prompt via intake_prior= (no graph skip). MAILROOM_BERT_INTAKE default off, fail-open.

data.label: Gmail triage lane
data.desc: Auxiliary flow outside the graph: single-document email intake on a free model, with allowlist + DMARC guards and a durable outbox.

data.label: relations clerk
data.desc: Post-archive deterministic association scan dispatched at every terminal manifest, with optional LLM judgment (relations.llm, off in pilot).

data.label: relations graph views
data.desc: Ledger projections from the scan: matter graph, global matter graph and document ego-graph (GraphJSON/GraphML, optional Plotly/PNG).

data.label: operator pager
data.desc: SMS pager: ten alert rules, quiet hours, catch-up digests; default off; mailroom.pager/v1 payload.

data.label: provider health
data.desc: Passive per-provider LLM health (src/llm/provider_health.py, provider_health.json under fcntl flock) that feeds the pager.

data.label: Jev route gate
data.desc: Opt-in learned route gate (TypeSafe System One): overrides only the medium confidence band once its calibration exists; off by default.

data.label: mailroom-reloaded (CrewAI Flows)
data.desc: Compressed deployment-ready mailroom: ingest → bert_primary → sort → gate_classify → extract → gate_extract → report_catalog_archive (one node), with verify/boss/grade branches off the gates.

data.label: local-mailroom-sandbox
data.desc: Local-first sandbox: the full graph offline on Ollama / vLLM / llama.cpp / LM Studio, plus Modal GPU studies; tracked vendor/ snapshots.

data.label: mailroom-sandbox (fork)
data.desc: Organization fork of the sandbox (SAND-032 Modal + vLLM leg); development continues in the Exios66 original.

data.label: Modal vLLM app (mailroom-vllm)
data.desc: OpenAI-compatible Qwen3-8B-AWQ on an L4 with Prometheus metrics — the reloaded pipeline's GPU serving app.

data.label: reloaded observability stack
data.desc: Docker-compose sidecars: Phoenix :6006, Prometheus :9090, Grafana :3000 (Pipeline / Serving & GPU / Quality dashboards).

data.label: FastAPI producer
data.desc: The pipeline's HTTP surface (/v1): upload, run and review endpoints.

data.label: inbox watcher
data.desc: Claims each inbox file exactly once (worker-scoped lock); a stale claim older than WATCHER_STALE_CLAIM_MINUTES is re-queued and the graph re-runs from intake.

data.label: watchdog
data.desc: Outside-the-watcher watchdog: heartbeat poll plus status e-mail (down/reminder); MAILROOM_WATCHDOG=0 kill switch. It also hosts the pager service.

data.label: filesystem bins
data.desc: inbox → processing → archive | review | failed, with JSON manifests per document.

data.label: hash-chained audit log
data.desc: SQLite hash chain — later tampering is detectable.

data.label: matter catalog
data.desc: Matter records and window stats that the pager and boards read.

data.label: provider router
data.desc: Routes each call per the agent's taxonomy provider — OpenRouter / Ollama / vLLM (local, Modal, or a LiteLLM gateway) / llamafile / generic — with per-provider cost models.

data.label: config/taxonomy.yaml
data.desc: Canonical document classes, subclasses, per-agent providers and thresholds.

data.label: Langfuse tracing wiring
data.desc: One document-pipeline trace per document, mandatory tags, file-metadata-only input, span e-mail masking.

data.label: The-Mailroom
data.desc: Pixel-art visual engine + hosted Observatory. Langfuse traces are its only source of truth — nothing on screen is invented.

data.label: pixel console
data.desc: CRT conveyor floor: every run as animated document envelopes (mailroom-web).

data.label: hosted Observatory
data.desc: The public operations desk (mailroom-hosted / /live). Its Hugging Face Space is currently paused (503), not deleted.

data.label: TUI
data.desc: Typed-command REPL over the display API (mailroom-tui).

data.label: terminal site
data.desc: owlcot-style TTY site — live at /terminal/ (the Pages root redirects to it; pixel console at /pixel/). Board card DMR-013 is still open, but the publish landed 2026-09-28.

data.label: dataset viewer
data.desc: “corpus …” commands: slim windowed dataset listing plus live per-row doc_text and ground truth.

data.label: constellation repo browser
data.desc: “repos …” commands: every mirror package plus the hub copies.

data.label: Dispatch Board (board-site)
data.desc: Served Kanban dispatch board — the hub's deploy root, on Vercel, backed by kanban-labelled issues.

data.label: Producer Space
data.desc: Producer Space — not published (Hub 404). The producer runs from deploy/docker-compose.producer.yml; without it the Observatory's Inbox/REVIEW answer an honest 503.

data.label: reloaded UI / TUI / replay
data.desc: Read-mostly reloaded surface: catalog, audit chain, replay timelines and the ledger over /ui and /tui.

data.label: llm-mailroom-graph
data.desc: Graphify AST knowledge graph of llm-mailroom (1,905 symbols, 4,557 edges, 104 communities). Graph sites were pruned from the constellation in DMR-079.

data.label: mailroom-dev-graph
data.desc: Earlier-generation graphify site of the mailroom-dev monorepo (4,870 symbols, 16,161 edges, 325 communities).

data.label: DMR-Graph (this site)
data.desc: This site: the pruned constellation's architecture knowledge graph — networkx model, Cytoscape.js view, GH Pages deployed locally with no Actions.

data.label: agent-mailroom
data.desc: Self-contained mailroom: one graph run per document (the watcher claims each file exactly once), hive mailboxes, two LLM calls on the happy path. Preserved on branch feature/agent-mailroom.

data.label: walking office floor
data.desc: LimeZu rooms, walking avatars, thought clouds, flying envelopes (agent-mailroom's pixel floor).

data.label: Digital-Mailroom (hub)
data.desc: Central truth: uv monorepo, governance, wiki, dispatch board and the release chain. Seven packages after the DMR-079 prune.

data.label: uv workspace
data.desc: One pyproject + uv.lock across packages: workspace sources in development, published git pins at release.

data.label: docs/constellation/
data.desc: The canonical written map (repo index, architecture flows, data rules, governance) that this graph renders.

data.label: docs/v7-taxonomy.md
data.desc: Canonical prose contract for the v7 five-class corpus vs the live taxonomy, plus the v8 subclass strata (HUB-028/HUB-041).

data.label: docs/wiki/
data.desc: Version-controlled wiki (16 pages): Architecture, Releases, HF-Corpus, Subagents, Sandbox, Served-Board… The Architecture page still describes the removed after_intake skip — the code is the truth.

data.label: specialist subagent roster
data.desc: .opencode/agents (16 files) + .devin mirror: orchestrator-governor, prompt-engineer (GEPA provenance pin), archivist, data, testing, UI, systems, Modal/vLLM.

data.label: governance/TASKS.md
data.desc: Single-source board: lanes unassigned → assigned → in_progress → needs_attention → done, closing with Evidence naming the commits.

data.label: data/ + manifests
data.desc: Corpus governance for the pinned revision.

data.label: reports/
data.desc: Index only — the EDA deliverables live under each package (e.g. packages/mailroom-corpus-eda/reports/), tracked in full per HUB-008.

data.label: mailroom-issues
data.desc: Constellation-wide issue store and label taxonomy (223 issues, 34 open) + frozen-v1 reference copies and the generated cross-repo reports. No code.

data.label: cost & GPU reports
data.desc: Master, Modal-vs-API cost comparison and Modal vLLM GPU reports with figures — generated by the sandbox dashboard export into mailroom-issues.

data.label: CHANGELOG.md
data.desc: Keep-a-Changelog source of truth for the hub chain; every release body is compiled from its stamped section.

data.label: board_state.py
data.desc: Board parser and gate: status | card | check | sync-issues | pull-issues | project-init.

data.label: sync_packages.py
data.desc: Subtree ↔ Exios66/* mirror sync against 7 remotes: status | pull | push | snapshot.

data.label: taxonomy_parity.py
data.desc: Document-class + subclass parity gate across five surfaces, pinned to mailroom-dataset v9.1 (rev ed7576b6); voicemail → other.

data.label: release_chain.py
data.desc: Changelog ↔ semver tag ↔ pyproject version governor: status | check | cut X.Y.Z --apply --tag.

data.label: release_notes.py
data.desc: Renders .github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md with highlights, merged PRs and key commits — release bodies are never hand-typed.

data.label: deploy_gh_pages.py
data.desc: Local GitHub Pages deploy (force-push gh-pages + enable via API) — no Actions. The pattern DMR-Graph reuses.

data.label: audit_references.py
data.desc: Org-migration reference audit (DMR-006): exits 1 on any non-allowlisted stale pre-migration reference.

data.label: sync_vendor.py
data.desc: Refreshes the sandbox's tracked vendor/ snapshots from the workspace packages (--check drift gate).

data.label: github_labels.py
data.desc: Sync/audit of the GitHub label set from .github/labels.json (the manifest is source of truth).

data.label: gen_interactive_charts.py
data.desc: Plotly interactive HTML charts for the claims-data-eda and Enron EDA reports.

data.label: sync-wiki.sh
data.desc: Mirrors the version-controlled wiki to the GitHub wiki (--check gate).

data.label: .github templates & labels
data.desc: Issue / PR / hub-card templates, the 33-label manifest and the release template.

data.label: .github/workflows
data.desc: Four workflows: board-governance (blocking gates), release-governance (tag-push chain check), dependabot auto-merge, feeder-resync applier.

data.label: Hub v0.8.0 — rollback point
data.desc: Annotated tag 5a2900c5 (dbc79ca3) — the last release containing all ten packages, captured before the consolidation prune.

data.label: DMR-079 consolidation prune
data.desc: 0ac7e4bc (PR #131, close-out e8558a68) — prunes llm-entity-extraction, llm-mailroom-graph and agent-mailroom; seven packages remain.

data.label: open hub cards (DMR-080/081)
data.desc: DMR-080: the phantom required `ci` status context blocks every PR to main (workflow deleted, protection unchanged) — merges need --admin. DMR-081: dead archive-date UTC gate.

data.label: earlier monorepos
data.desc: mailroom-hub (first, 2026-08-30) and mailroom-dev (superseded 2026-09-26); the HUB-era mailroom-ops is documented as archived but no longer resolves on GitHub.

data.label: Hugging Face Hub
data.desc: Datasets, models and Spaces under Lucius-Morningstar — the only published data plane.

data.label: Langfuse (US cloud)
data.desc: Traces and managed prompts (mailroom-<agent>, production label) — the visualizer's source of truth.

data.label: Arize Phoenix
data.desc: OTel-native tracing; The-Mailroom reads mailroom-reloaded spans through it. Eval runs never mix with production traces.

data.label: Braintrust
data.desc: Hosted eval datasets, read-only; span logging disabled by default so runs never burn plan quota.

data.label: Modal (GPU)
data.desc: GPU serving for vLLM tiers; cost basis A100 $2.10/h, L4 $0.80/h (DMR-078 / SAND-032 rate table).

data.label: OpenRouter
data.desc: Hosted models for the pipeline — and the free model behind the Gmail triage lane.

data.label: Docker / Docker Hub
data.desc: Container deploy path: docker-compose profiles plus the Docker Hub release (make image-push); Railway is not used here.

data.label: Ollama
data.desc: Default local provider (qwen3:8b, fallback qwen3:7b).

data.label: vLLM
data.desc: Local and Modal vLLM serving.

data.label: llama.cpp
data.desc: GGUF sidecar serving.

data.label: LM Studio
data.desc: Desktop local serving for sandbox runs.

data.label: SQLite
data.desc: Sandbox storage and the pipeline's persistence default.

data.label: Vercel
data.desc: Hosts the Dispatch Board and the eval-environment viewer.

data.label: GitHub Pages
data.desc: Branch-deployed static sites — no Actions anywhere on the constellation's Pages path.

data.label: kanban-labelled issues
data.desc: GitHub issues are the backing store of the served dispatch board; board_state.py mirrors lanes two ways.
